## AI becomes a growth channel only when it plugs into testing cadence.


Creative velocity usually moves first. Performance metrics improve only after teams build disciplined review loops and variant refresh cadence.


Without a real operating model, AI increases output volume but also increases confusion. Workflow maturity determines whether speed creates leverage.

Do we run daily generation and edit queues?


Do we have twice-weekly review and refresh cycles?


Are hooks and assets planned weekly, not ad hoc?


Is output tied to testable growth hypotheses?
